title: The Point Where Water Becomes Root Forever

features.name: the-merger
features.desc-on-touch: Water suspends where root begins; you sense no boundary between the two. The merger holds perfectly still.

features.name: ascending-root
features.desc-on-touch: Root tangles upward through water as if water were soil. Spiralling, methodical, alive.

features.name: root-language
features.desc-on-touch: Carved on bark, the alphabet that roots use to speak. Water has memorized every letter.

features.name: threshold-wireframe
features.desc-on-touch: What you touch is neither earth nor water; it yields to both hands at once, teaching them a third grammar.

features.name: held-breath
features.desc-on-touch: In this stillness, everything waits; nothing decides which it is. The archive learns that indecision can be a form of completion.

inscription: here water learned to root; it draws from above and below at once, and the forest has forgotten which direction feeds which.

file.name: Osmosis_And_Grammar_FieldNotes.txt
file.note: Field notes on how root systems conduct water upward through impossible heights; margins fill with metaphors neither author intended.

reverie.title: REVERIE — root-learning at first light
narr: You and she stood in the shallows where the bank roots
played through water like fingers learning music. The
water held the roots; the roots held the water. She
said: 'Look—nothing decides.' You understood then that
the archive itself wanted to be both at once.
